items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, not Stuff Smith. Now you‘ve done named two, now he was just as good as them two men you named.

ctx.x: Stuff Smith? Stuff Smith? Stuff Smith.
No, not Stuff Smith. Now you‘ve done named two, now he was just as good as them two men you named. He was a little younger than they were, he also played saxophone and violin.
